elements.element: Non-solicit obligation is mutual (binds Vendor as well as Customer)
elements.evidence: 12.5 "Vendor is subject to the same restriction with respect to Customer's personnel, so that neither Party will solicit the other Party's personnel"

elements.element: Restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services
elements.evidence: 12.4 as revised still reads "Customer will not solicit any person employed by Vendor at any time"; only 12.5 adds "who are directly involved in the Services", leaving the Customer-side covenant broader on its face

elements.element: Duration of 12 months running from the end of that person's involvement
elements.evidence: 12.4 "For 12 months after the end of their involvement"; 12.5 "only for 12 months from the end of that person's involvement in the Services"

elements.element: Carve-out for responses to general advertisements
elements.evidence: 12.5 "does not appl[y] to a person who responds to a general advertisement not targeted at the other Party's personnel"
"engage" deleted from 12.4 ("will not solicit any person"); 12.3 retains "Customer has made no ... no-hire commitment"

elements.element: No non-solicit binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: 12.4 "Customer will not solicit any person employed by Vendor" remains in force

reasons: The Customer-side covenant in 12.4 was not narrowed to service personnel: it still covers "any person employed by Vendor at any time", which is broader than the fallback's "personnel directly involved in the services" and is the very asymmetry we are trying to fix.

12.4 and 12.5 now conflict on scope: 12.5 says "neither Party will solicit the other Party's personnel who are directly involved in the Services" while 12.4 covers any Vendor employee, creating an ambiguity a vendor will read against us.

The revised 12.4 uses "the end of their involvement" with no antecedent — "their" is dangling because 12.4 no longer identifies personnel involved in the Services; the involvement concept only appears in 12.5.

Fix minimally by editing 12.4 to read: "For 12 months after the end of a person's involvement in the Services, Customer will not solicit any Vendor personnel directly involved in the Services," and deleting "at any time", so the mutual sentence in 12.5 sits on a matching Customer-side obligation.
